name: EvoWorld.io
summary: EvoWorld.io is a multiplayer evolution-survival game where players begin as a small fly and work their way through a food chain by eating, drinking water, avoiding predators, and gaining experience to evolve into increasingly powerful creatures. Each evolution introduces different abilities, prey, predators, and ways to survive across a variety of biomes, with the progression eventually leading to the Grim Reaper. The game also features player skins, pets, a shop, events, and other progression and customization systems.
